description: Punctuality at a station on the previous operating day, from SBB's published actual times: number of stops, share of on-time arrivals and departures (SBB's delay threshold, about 3 minutes), cancellations, and the lines with the most delayed arrivals. Optional line filter (e.g. 'IC1', 'S3'). Example: {station:'Olten'}.

line.description: Only this line, e.g. IC1, IR15, S3

name: get_station_punctuality
title: Yesterday's punctuality at an SBB station
